title: Multiplying my 247% Profit in Pot Stocks
text:
Frankly, I’ve just developed a brand-new trading strategy…
Allowing us to profit from America’s fastest growing sector of the economy.
Legalized marijuana.
Go here for urgent trading details.
Investment is about opportunity.
There are truly only a handful of times in our lives where we have the opportunity to invest in something that has the potential to make significant returns.
But what is even more rare is that we can invest in a viable, sustainable sector…one that is in its infancy and has a realistic chance to be one of the best investments of our lifetime.
Right now that opportunity is the cannabis sector (click here for details).
Right now, we’re witnessing the emergence of a major new industry.
An industry that undoubtedly is one of the fastest growing industries in the world. The global legal cannabis industry grew 37% in 2017 to reach $9.5 billion.
Some analysts expect it to reach $50 billion by 2020 and $100 billion by $2029!
Personally, I believe the opportunity is real.
That’s why I invested in a Canadian company called Aphria (APHQF) a couple years ago.
In December, 2017 I bought shares in APHQF for $3.55.
Today shares trades for $12.31…
That’s a 247% profit!
That’s a huge gain. But here’s the best news…
It’s just the start. Because I’ve uncovered an amazing strategy that could multiply these 247% gains – by more than 3X!
There are tons of tiny cannabis stocks that are complete garbage.
But there’s 7 major players that stand to hand investors life-changing gains.
Individual and institutional investors are flocking to the sector – and sending these stocks surging.
Most people are accustomed to the standard “buy-and-hold” investments. But, what if I told you there was a strategy out there that would allow you to make 3X – 5X the gains on the same stocks?
It’s completely possible. And I know because…
For the last few years I’ve been doing this strategy in some of the biggest blue-chip and growth stocks. Stocks like Pfizer (PFE), Coca-Cola (KO), Caterpillar (CAT), Apple (AAPL), Twitter (TWTR) and numerous others.
The returns have been tremendous. Shares of Pfizer are up 11.8%, my strategy is up 49.7%. Shares of Coca-Cola are up 11.2%, my strategy is up 51.4%. Shares of Caterpillar are up 51.2%, my strategy is up 108.2% Shares of Apple are up 21.2%, my strategy is up 91.0% Shares of Twitter are up 53.9%, my strategy is up 145.2%
That’s right.
This unique trading strategy typically lets me earn 300% – 500% bigger profits.
Now, you may be thinking…
“It must be risky.”
But nothing could be further from the truth…
Because this strategy actually REDUCES RISK…
While allowing you to maximize your upside potential.
Remember…
Legal cannabis is a once-in-a-decade opportunity.
There hasn’t been a bigger growth sector since the dot com boom in the 1990s.
My top stocks are like buying Amazon in 1997… Google in 2004… or Facebook in 2012.
